decisions.reason: A particle therapy water phantom is a high-investment system serving a growing proton therapy niche, so the firm will keep supporting it as part of its scanning portfolio.
Small volume chambers for small-field and stereotactic QA remain in steady demand and fit the firm's dosimetry line with long product lifecycles.
This complementary small volume chamber has low ongoing cost and serves established clinical QA needs, so withdrawal is unlikely.
Standard clinical ionization chambers are a staple of absolute dosimetry and tied to the accredited calibration business.
Relative dosimetry chambers are needed for water phantom scanning workflows and integrate with the firm's systems.
Thimble chambers are established reference instruments with long lifecycles and stable demand.
